name: Cloudflare Node Cache Clear
description: Purges Cloudflare CDN cache per node or site-wide, with optional per-language zones, Drush commands, and client-IP restoration.
project_description:
This module integrates with the Cloudflare API service. Gives an admin user the ability to clear cache on a per node basis or can purge for the whole site (zone).

 Features 
 
 Clear cache per node url. Action button added to node edit form. 
 Clear all cache for site/configured zone. 
 Works with both API key & token. Configure one of the two for usage. 
 Can configure multiple zones per language/domain. 
 Drush commands to flush cache and place a zone into under-attack mode. 
 
 Required 
 
 Cloudflare SDK (will be installed via Composer). 
 Cloudflare API Account (Email, API Key or Token & Zone Id is required). 
 Key module. 
 
 Install/Usage 
 Install via Composer to get all dependencies:

 composer require drupal/cloudflare_node_cc 

 
 Install and enable module like any other contributed module. 
 Add your API key or token via the Key module. 
 Configure Cloudflare API settings at /admin/config/services/cloudflare-node-cache-clear 
 If purging a single node cache, please visit the edit page of the node and purge via action button. 
 If purging whole site wide cache, go through admin toolbar tools menu item "Purge Cloudflare Cache" or via: /admin/cloudflare-node-cache-clear/purge-cache 
 Back to top
